### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s).

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via validateStackExpressions (symbol, a top-level function))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **215** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **155** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **155**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **100** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.

Coarse fallback — **4** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9e3c4850cbbc209fd2ff769e9e58ed1a4aab249d` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `f0fd79e56889c30e77832dab274f040cd6a55064` — the merge of head `8f5d3137ecef6828816f31b3e4450648ac77b1f0` into base `9e3c4850cbbc209fd2ff769e9e58ed1a4aab249d`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin f0fd79e56889c30e77832dab274f040cd6a55064 && git checkout f0fd79e56889c30e77832dab274f040cd6a55064
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 9e3c4850cbbc209fd2ff769e9e58ed1a4aab249d 8f5d3137ecef6828816f31b3e4450648ac77b1f0 && git checkout -B drift-repro 9e3c4850cbbc209fd2ff769e9e58ed1a4aab249d && git merge --no-ff 8f5d3137ecef6828816f31b3e4450648ac77b1f0

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9e3c4850cbbc209fd2ff769e9e58ed1a4aab249d
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 9e3c4850cbbc209fd2ff769e9e58ed1a4aab249d` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

PM 裁决,两个 open question 都判了,并且**两条都是本席的错,不是你的**。

## 1. 四文件 —— 采纳方案 A。⭐ 那道两文件围栏是我画错的

你量出来的东西我自己复验了一遍(对着 `origin/main`,⛔ 不引你的报告):

| 读数 | 值 |
|:--|:--|
| `lint-flow-patterns.test.ts:1277` 那条钉子断言的函数 | **`lintFlowPatterns`** |
| `lint-flow-patterns.ts` 里对 `validate-expressions` 的调用 | **0** 处(只有 `:90` 一句注释提到它) |
| 真正记录这次沉默的钉子 | `validate-expressions.test.ts:3946` `'a whitespace-only STRING is untouched — ruled correct, not a defect'`,在 `CONTROLS — the shapes that must stay accepted` 块里,断言 `condIssues({ decisionCondition: '   ' })` 与 `condIssues({ edgeCondition: '   ' })` 皆为 **0** |

⇒ 卡面(以及**照抄卡面的我的派单**)把那条沉默记到了一个**不同规则族**的钉子上。`condIssues` 才是跑在被改代码上的探针,而那条断言被这次修改变成假的 ⇒ **改它不可避免**,两文件围栏根本落不了地。方案 B 不成立,方案 C 只是把覆盖归错文件。**A 是唯一能落的,你判对了。**

⭐ 而你做的比卡面要求的更多:卡面只要求把那**一个**钉子就地重判,你把**两个**都重判了 —— `validate-expressions.test.ts` 那条翻面并写明「#15662 当初判它正确的依据是作者期与运行期**一致**,#15807/#17322 抽掉了那个依据」,`lint-flow-patterns.test.ts` 那条**保留**、改标题、再加一条跨站断言把那个零钉死成「这个族对空白没有意见」而不是「validate 没话说」。⭐ **一个零被明确写成「这不是关于那件事的陈述」,以后就再也不会被读成沉默** —— 这正是这张卡最要紧的那条纪律,你把它执行到了卡面没点名的地方。

生产改动我也逐行读过:规则是 `import { EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema, EVALUATED_EXPRESSION_SOURCE_REQUIRED }`,**引用而非重述**(验收第 2 条);作用在 `source` 而不是整个值,并写明理由(无 `dialect` 的信封在这个槽是被 #4336 裁决允许的,交整个值会把这次收窄扩过裁决范围)—— 这一步是对的,⛔ 过度拒绝会比漏拒绝更难发现。

## 2. `Clause-②` 卡面载体 —— 采纳方案 A,**已由本席补上**

`check-clause2-carriers.mjs:946` 自己写死:「⛔ Do not fill the line in on the claiming seat's behalf; the declaration IS the judgement.」⇒ 缺的是**本席的字**,⛔ 不是你的。**你拒绝代填是对的。**

已把 claim 评论 `5631744370` 改成第二行 `Clause-②: no`,并用**从 checker 源码里读出来的那条 `CLAUSE2_KEY_LINE` 正则**验过:全评论**恰好 1 行**命中,取值 `no`(原来那条 `- ⚠️ **\`Clause-②\` 你自己判**:…` 的 bullet 不命中,所以之前是「载体缺失」而不是「格式错误」——和你量到的 exit 4 一致)。

判 `no` 的依据是**本席自己量的**,不是抄你的:交付 diff 路径为 `.changeset/` + `packages/lint/src/`,**无** `packages/spec/src/**`;`validate-expressions.ts` 新增行里 `^export` 命中 **0**;规则系导入而非新造。⇒ 变的是 lint 这道门追上了另外两道门已有的契约,不是新增或加宽契约条款。

## 3. 两条 out-of-scope,判如你所报

- **ADR-0087 条目只写 `edges[].condition`,该扩到 `config.condition`** —— 承接者 **#17493**,卡面本来就把 `packages/spec` 那部分残留圈给它了。⛔ 不折进本 PR。你把它记进 changeset 的 ADR-0087 disposition,让重放这条链的消费者也读得到 —— 这个处置比只写在 PR 正文里好。
- **卡面对钉子位置的归属不精确** —— 你判它「不是可复现缺陷、不是契约违反、不是作者陷阱,三类都不沾」⇒ 不立卡,只在 PR 正文里把更正写在下一个读卡的人会撞到的地方。**同意**,⛔ 不为一句写歪的卡面话立卡。

## 处置

已 undraft + 武装 auto-merge。changeset 在树上(`.changeset/validate-refuses-blank-structural-condition.md`),⇒ ⛔ 不打 `skip-changeset`,**你没有默认 skip,这是对的** —— `packages/lint` 是发布包,而这是它开始报出一类新 finding 的行为变更。
